tcs.test_item:
The software shall enable/disable GPS time synchronization based on NAV_Presence, GPS_Presence, and user settings
(confirm GPS time is enabled only when the NAV Proxi parameter is present)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to ON
3. Read the state of "Set Time Hours" and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows ON
3. "Set Time Hours" is greyed out
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks:
PENDING: DR-5 CFTS015 缺件物件 6151331
PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4813922 之條件為 Proxi $NAV_Presence$ = [Present] 且設定已開啟。NAV_Presence 為 PROXI 參數（值域取自 data/proxi_atlantis_high.tsv，Atlantis & Atlantis High (col 16-20, Proxi sheet)），**非 CAN 訊號**，故寫入前置條件而不寫訊號三件組。

PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4813939 逐字：ON 時 disable the 'SET TIME' feature，OFF 時 enable —— 本條驗 OFF 方向。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall use internal clock when GPS data is temporarily unavailable and switch back when available
(confirm the internal clock takes over when the GPS signal is lost)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to ON
3. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
4. PENDING: DR-10 Bench 使 GPS 訊號不可用之操作方式
5. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows ON
3. The HU display shows the GPS clock value
4. The GPS signal is unavailable
5. The HU display continues to advance from the last GPS value using the internal clock
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.reasoning: 4813950 逐字：GPS TIME ON 時以內部時鐘為 backup（GPS signal lost condition）。

tcs.test_item:

tcs.expected_result:

tcs.test_item:
The software shall use internal clock when GPS data is temporarily unavailable and switch back when available
(confirm the internally calculated time is sent until the GPS data is ready)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to ON
3. Turn the ignition to OFF
4. Turn the ignition to ON
5. Read $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_UTC_Hour$ and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows ON
3. The ignition is OFF
4. The ignition is ON and the HU starts up
5. $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_UTC_Hour$ carries a value from the first transmission onward
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.reasoning: 4813959：GPS 資料備妥前送內部計算之時間，備妥後取代之。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 857（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain internal clock with ±2 sec accuracy per 24 hours when GPS is unavailable
(confirm the internal clock drift stays within the allowed error over a 24 hour period)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is an Atlantis High architecture variant
tcs.input_test_data: Reference time source accurate to 1 second
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to OFF
3. Set "Set Time Hours" and "Set Time Minutes" to the reference time
4. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it 24 hours later
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows OFF
3. The HU time matches the reference time
4. The HU time differs from the reference time by no more than 2 seconds
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.remarks:
PENDING: DR-5 CFTS015 缺件物件 6151328
PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4813936 逐字：+/- 2 seconds for each twenty four hour period (86400 seconds)。±2 秒為允許誤差之邊界，故取 BVA。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall transmit GPS-based date/time signals or SNA if unavailable
(confirm the GPS date fields are broadcast on the bus)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to ON
3. Read $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Year$ and record it
4. Read $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Month$ and record it
5. Read $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Day$ and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows ON
3. $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Year$ carries the current GPS year
4. $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Month$ carries the current GPS month
5. $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Day$ carries the current GPS day
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4813999 逐字列出三個 GPS 日期訊號。**本條不涵蓋 SNA 送出規則** —— 該規則屬 022（B-2 界線，R-TM55：該對無自動判準，人工確認）。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 856 / 859 / 861（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall transmit GPS-based date/time signals or SNA if unavailable
(confirm the GPS date fields follow a change in the GPS date)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to ON
3. Read $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Day$ and record it
4. PENDING: DR-10 使車輛時間跨越日界之操作方式
5. Read $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Day$ and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows ON
3. $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Day$ carries the starting GPS day
4. The GPS date is advanced by one day
5. $TELEMATIC_FD_1.GPS_Date_Day$ carries the new GPS day
tcs.reasoning: 4813999 之送出隨 GPS 資料變動。**不涵蓋 SNA**（B-2 界線）。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 856（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain an internal calendar and act as master for vehicle date (2010–2099 range)
(confirm the head unit keeps and transmits the vehicle date as master)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is an Atlantis High architecture variant
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Sync Time with GPS" to OFF
3. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to 15 / 06 / 2030
4. Read the date shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Sync Time with GPS" shows OFF
3. The date entry is accepted
4. The HU display shows 15/06/2030
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4814006 為 Radio 作為 vehicle date 之 master；4814011 之 a) 明訂依 Day/Month/Year Setting.Info 更新內部日期計數。UI 項名取自 HMI Settings List 第 7 節（Set Date Day / Month / Year）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall initialize time/date to default values after reset or battery reconnection
(confirm the date returns to its initial value after a battery reconnection)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to a date other than 1 January of the model year
3. Disconnect and reconnect the vehicle battery
4. Turn the ignition to ON
5. Read the date shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The date entry is accepted
3. The battery is reconnected
4. The ignition is ON and the HU starts up
5. The HU display shows 1 January of the model year
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 4814028 逐字：initialized to '1st of January of the year of $VC_Model_Year$'。$VC_Model_Year$ 為車輛配置參數而**非 CAN 訊號**，故不寫訊號三件組。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall initialize time/date to default values after reset or battery reconnection
(confirm the date returns to its initial value after a software reset)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to a date other than 1 January of the model year
3. PENDING: DR-8 ECU 軟體重置之操作方式
4. Read the date shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The date entry is accepted
3. The ECU is reset without a power interruption
4. The HU display shows 1 January of the model year
tcs.reasoning: 4814028 之 reset 觸發（018 逐字含 'after reset **or** battery reconnection' —— 兩者為需求明列之兩種觸發，不得以其一代替另一）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain time using internal counters during sleep and update on wakeup
(confirm the time continues to advance across a sleep and wakeup cycle)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is an Atlantis Mid architecture variant
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
2. PENDING: DR-9 CAN sleep 之可觀察終止條件
3. Wake the CAN bus
4. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU display shows a time value
2. The CAN bus has entered sleep
3. The CAN bus is awake
4. The HU display shows the time advanced by the elapsed duration
tcs.reasoning: 021 之唯一引用物件 4814066 標為 Atlantis Mid（`12` §2.2：Atl-Hi 錨點為零），依 R-TM64 之零真值例外，spec_reference 寫單一佔位，明細入 Remarks。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall maintain time using internal counters during sleep and update on wakeup
(confirm the time is updated on the bus after wakeup)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is an Atlantis Mid architecture variant
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-9 使 CAN bus 進入 sleep 之操作方式與可觀察終止條件
2. Wake the CAN bus
3. Read $TIME_DATE.Hour1$ and $TIME_DATE.Hour2$ and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The CAN bus has entered sleep
2. The CAN bus is awake
3. $TIME_DATE.Hour1$ / $TIME_DATE.Hour2$ carry the current hour value
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: 021 之 update on wakeup。spec_reference 同前條之零真值例外。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis (col 16-20) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。
